_about: Purpose classes for robots.txt product tokens. 'retrieval' tokens fetch pages to answer or cite in live AI search / assistant responses, or build the search index those answers draw on; blocking them removes the site from those answers. 'training' tokens govern collection or reuse for model training (some are control tokens, not crawlers); blocking them does not remove the site from live AI search citations. 'honors_robots_txt': false marks user-initiated fetchers whose operator says robots.txt rules may not apply -- a robots.txt block on them is not an effective access control, so it is never scored as one. Any token NOT listed here is 'unclassified' and handled like retrieval (the conservative choice).
_verification: 'verified' entries were checked against the operator's own crawler documentation on 2026-09-11 (OpenAI developers.openai.com/api/docs/bots; Anthropic support.claude.com article 8896518; Perplexity docs.perplexity.ai/guides/bots; Google developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/google-common-crawlers; Apple support.apple.com/en-us/119829; Meta developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/webmasters/web-crawlers). Entries with verified: false were not re-checked in that pass. Operators rename and add crawlers -- re-verify when updating.

oai-searchbot.note: surfaces sites in ChatGPT search; sites opted out are not shown in ChatGPT search answers

chatgpt-user.note: user-initiated fetches; OpenAI says robots.txt rules may not apply, and it does not decide Search inclusion

gptbot.note: content that may be used to train foundation models; does not control ChatGPT search

claude-searchbot.note: indexes content for Claude search result quality

claude-user.note: fetches pages for Claude user questions; blocking it may reduce visibility in user-directed search

claudebot.note: collects content that could contribute to model training

anthropic-ai.note: legacy token no longer listed in Anthropic's documentation; still present in many robots.txt files

perplexitybot.note: surfaces and links sites in Perplexity search results; not used to train foundation models

perplexity-user.note: user-requested fetches; Perplexity says it generally ignores robots.txt

googlebot.note: Google Search index, which AI Overviews draw on

google-extended.note: control token (no separate crawler) for Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps; does not affect inclusion or ranking in Google Search

bingbot.note: Bing index, which Copilot answers draw on

applebot.note: powers Spotlight, Siri and Safari search; data may also help train Apple foundation models

applebot-extended.note: control token (does not crawl) for use in training Apple foundation models; pages disallowing it can still appear in search results

meta-webindexer.note: improves Meta AI search result quality

meta-externalfetcher.note: fetches links at a user's request; Meta says it may bypass robots.txt

meta-externalagent.note: training foundation models and product indexing; Meta AI search quality uses Meta-WebIndexer

ccbot.note: open web corpus widely used for model training
